provenanceNote: Synthetic-original fixture: newly authored for the issue #104 regression. The receiver-call idioms (eventPlayer.setMoveSpeed(...), eventPlayer.getPosition(), eventPlayer.isAlive(), eventPlayer.getHealth(), eventPlayer.teleport(...), and the player-variable receiver) are the same forms exercised by the redistributable overpy-meipocalypse corpus; unsupported enum-gated methods from that corpus (setInvisibility/setStatusEffect with Invis/Status enums, worldVector with Transform) are intentionally excluded and remain structured diagnostics. Oracle en-US spellings for the exercised methods come from the pinned overpy@9.7.10 package surface.
